en: Black‑and‑white street view of a multi‑storey building with simple stucco facade and many rectangular windows. On the ground floor are several commercial signs in German, including a restaurant and an events hall. Two 1960s–1970s era cars (one resembling an East German Trabant) are parked on the cobbled street in front. Overhead utility lines cross the image, and curtains and signage are visible in the shop windows.
